title: Runtime Deployment Boundary

boundaries.scope: Buildable riido_ai_server process, HTTP routes, graceful shutdown, safe seed shape, and stdout EMF.
Manual or tag-triggered image-only ECS service promotion using stable environment configuration.
CodeDeploy creation/wait/smoke is public workflow execution; topology remains private infra.
Stdlib-only request construction and fake-endpoint verified behavior.
Git/tag, Go module, container contract result, and aggregate deploy/smoke pass-fail only.
does_not_own: task-definition ARNs, image digests, live workflow run URLs

rules: runtime artifact CD execution stays in riido-control-plane
riido-infra owns topology, IAM, drift, and private operator evidence
RIID-4835 defines the public export contract for aggregate-only deploy and smoke handoff
RIID-4839 keeps exact deploy and smoke key-name lists in runtime-cd-ownership.riido.json and workflow files
RIID-4842 treats public key names as a sensitivity budget and keeps broad summary docs linked, not duplicated
RIID-4845 keeps exact deploy and smoke key-name lists out of human-readable public docs
RIID-4853 allows aggregate deploy/smoke pass-fail status without live payload values while keeping live details private
public docs link to runtime-cd-ownership.riido.json instead of repeating exact deploy and smoke key lists
image values, task-definition values, CodeDeploy payloads, deployment IDs, and smoke payloads are not public hand-off artifacts
public workflows must not upload deployment artifacts from the live run
CodeDeploy Handoff is topology-gated and runtime artifact CD execution still belongs to riido-control-plane

loop.observation: The runtime deployment boundary was a prose document even though most of its rules were already enforced by runtime CD ownership and deploy redaction tests.
loop.hypothesis: A compact boundary manifest can generate the reader and verify that each ownership claim has an executable source.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the boundary manifest and verify linked workflow, source, container, deploy policy, and runtime-CD ownership evidence.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on stale generated docs, missing evidence anchors, missing linked runtime-CD manifest shape, or missing public redaction phrases.
loop.retrospective: This keeps public/private deployment interpretation narrow while leaving live AWS evidence in infra/operator systems.
